# Verifier test fixtures

Synthetic PDFs generated by `packages/verifier/scripts/gen-fixtures.ts` using
node-forge for cert + CMS PKCS#7 detached signing. Regenerate with:

```bash
node --experimental-strip-types packages/verifier/scripts/gen-fixtures.ts
```

## Files

| Fixture                     | Purpose                                               |
| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `unsigned.pdf`              | Minimal valid PDF, no /Sig dictionary                 |
| `bb-valid.pdf`              | PAdES B-B, RSA-2048 + SHA-256, self-signed root       |
| `hash-mismatch.pdf`         | bb-valid with 1 byte mutated inside /ByteRange        |
| `weak-sha1.pdf`             | Same flow but digest = SHA-1 (REJECTED_HASH_OIDS hit) |
| `rsa-1024.pdf`              | RSA-1024 key (under the 2048 floor)                   |
| `expired-cert.pdf`          | Cert notBefore/notAfter both in the past              |
| `untrusted-root.pdf`        | Identical to bb-valid; not in ARCOTEL TSL → invalid   |
| `incremental-tampered.pdf`  | bb-valid + bytes appended after %%EOF                 |

## Limitations

These are **synthetic** fixtures with self-signed certs. They cover parser-level
properties of the verifier (`pdf.ts`, `cms.ts`, `integrity.ts`) but do **not**
substitute for real PAdES PDFs from each ARCOTEL ECI — those remain a Task 11
follow-up that requires user-provided files (Plan §11). Real fixtures should
land here with names matching `<eci-slug>-pades-<profile>.pdf`.

## Why node-forge

`node-forge` is a pure-JS PKCS implementation that runs in Node without
build-time native dependencies, making fixtures reproducible across CI workers.
For test ergonomics it's strictly limited to fixture generation — production
verification uses pkijs + Web Crypto.

## Real ACE leaf certificates

| Fixture              | Issuer                      | Purpose                                    |
| -------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `leaf-bce.der`       | AC Banco Central del Ecuador | `ecCertIdentity` arc `1.3.6.1.4.1.37947.3` |
| `leaf-uanataca.der`  | UANATACA CA2 2016           | arc `1.3.6.1.4.1.47286.102.3`, inside SAN  |

Public certificates only — no private keys, and the tests assert on properties
(digit count, mod-10 checksum, RUC/cédula prefix relation) rather than on the
values, so no cédula is written into the repository.
